name: Find Intersecting Features by Geometry
description: Query target layers in a Feature Service for records whose geometry intersects an Esri JSON boundary you provide. Supports polygon (`rings`), polyline (`paths`), and point (`x` / `y`) geometries and returns per-layer attribute arrays. [See the documentation](https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/query-feature-service-layer-.htm)
